title: Steve Reich, "Music for 18 Musicians" - FULL PERFORMANCE with eighth blackbird
summary: A full performance of Steve Reich's Music for 18 Musicians by eighth blackbird with Third Coast Percussion and others, recorded in Chicago in 2011. It is an hour-long minimalist piece built on phasing and repeating patterns.
why: Recommended in coding-music threads as lyric-free, repetitive music that aids focus.
